description: FR-INV-001 / FR-PADM-1.4.3 - Item Master. The BRD gives 'item code, category, HSN/SAC' (FR-PADM-1.4) and the worked example IF-1500 / Induction Furnace / HSN 8514 / UOM Nos.

fields.label: Category
fields.description: Category, so two spellings cannot mean two groups

fields.label: Stock UOM
fields.description: UOM (BRD 1.4.2 worked example); UOM Master is FR-PADM-1.4.7; 'Nos' and 'nos' were previously different units

fields.label: Standard Warranty (Months)
fields.description: How long the maker's warranty runs from commissioning. Leave blank if the item carries none. When a unit is commissioned, a warranty of this length is drafted for it, for you to confirm.

fields.label: Main Product
fields.description: Tick for a product made from other items, such as a board. Its raw materials, and how many of each, are listed below.

fields.label: Raw Materials Used
fields.description: How many different raw materials the group lists.

fields.label: Total Units Used
fields.description: The counts added up: how many pieces one product takes.

fields.label: Raw Materials
fields.description: Everything one of this product uses. A raw material can be in any number of products. A line can be another main product, which puts that product's group inside this one.

fields.label: Valuation Method
fields.description: Stock Valuation -- DEC-023. Ind AS 2 paragraph 25 permits only these two, so LIFO is not offered. The same paragraph requires one formula per class of similar inventory, which is why this is per item rather than per company. Left empty, FIFO applies.

fields.label: Brand
fields.description: Item Master -- brand the item is sold under

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Item Master -- default description copied onto document lines

fields.label: Is Sales Item
fields.description: May appear on a quotation or order

fields.label: Is Purchase Item
fields.description: May appear on a purchase order

fields.label: Disabled
fields.description: Withdrawn from selection without losing history

name: KNIT 360 Item
